content.title: Oscars 2026: See Photos Of Red Carpet Arrivals
content.text: HOLLYWOOD, CALIFORNIA - MARCH 15: EJAE attends the 98th Oscars at Dolby Theatre on March 15, 2026 in Hollywood, California. (Photo by Mike Coppola/Getty Images)Getty ImagesThe 2026 Oscars were Sunday night, but before the Academy Awards ceremony began, the stars arrived on the event’s red carpet.The Oscars ceremony, of course, is presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts & Sciences, which is celebrating the award celebration’s 98th year. ForbesOscars 2026: Complete List Of WinnersBy Tim LammersWriter-director Ryan Coogler’s Sinners led all of the nominees with 16 nominations going into the 98th Academy Awards, followed by writer-director Paul Thomas Anderson’s action comedy One Battle After Another with 13 nods. Both films competed for the Best Picture Oscar, along with Bugonia, F1: The Movie, Frankenstein, Hamnet, Marty Supreme, The Secret Agent and Train Dreams.One Battle After Another was the big winner of the night with six Oscars, including Best Picture, and Best Director and Best Adapted Screeenplay for Anderson.ForbesOscars 2026 In Memoriam Snubs Include Brigitte Bardot, James Van Der Beek And OthersBy Tim LammersMORE FOR YOUThe 98th Oscars were handed out at the Dolby Theater at Ovation Hollywood in Los Angeles and were hosted by 2025 emcee Conan O’Brien.
